'''2001 Alabama State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Alabama in 2001. [[Andy McClure]] won it.<ref name="dt-15300">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15300 All Your Base Are Belong To Us], DeckTech (Andy "Solo337" McClure, 16 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15300/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15300/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2001 (before 16 April)
* '''Site:''' Alabama
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Andy McClure]]

The event is known from players' DeckTech posts; they give no exact date. It was played before the [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] expansion was released on 30 May 2001.

== Results ==

Results below come from players' own DeckTech deck posts. Each row cites the post that gives it. A Dark or Light cell shows — until the deck page is linked.

McClure won Alabama States again in 2001 with his Dark ISB Operations scum deck, having also won the 2000 Alabama State Championship and DragonCon 2000 with earlier versions of it. At States he played Sunsdown & Too Cold For Speeders instead of the posted Resistance, and Endor Occupation instead of Power Of The Hutt.<ref name="dt-15300" />
